sanskrit: droṇaduryodhanakṛpāḥ karṇamadreśabāhlikāḥ duḥśāsanādayaḥ śaktās trātum apy antakādritam
english: Droṇa, Duryodhana, and Kṛpa, Karṇa, the lord of the Madras, and Bāhlika, Duḥśāsana and the rest are able to rescue even one beset by Death himself.

sanskrit: kim aṅga punar ekena phalgunena jighāṃsatā na trāyeyur bhavanto māṃ samastāḥ patayaḥ kṣiteḥ
english: How much more, then, when it is a single Phalguna who seeks to slay me — could you not protect me, you lords of the earth, all together?

sanskrit: praharṣaṃ pāṇḍaveyānāṃ śrutvā mama mahad bhayam sīdantīva ca me 'ṅgāni mumūrṣor iva pārthivāḥ
english: Hearing the exultation of the Pāṇḍavas, great is my fear, O kings; my limbs grow faint, as though I were a man about to die.

sanskrit: vadho nūnaṃ pratijñāto mama gāṇḍīvadhanvanā tathā hi hṛṣṭāḥ krośanti śokakāle 'pi pāṇḍavāḥ
english: Surely my slaying has been vowed by the wielder of the Gāṇḍīva, for the Pāṇḍavas, even in a time of grief, shout aloud in their joy.

sanskrit: na devā na ca gandharvā nāsuroragarākṣasāḥ utsahante 'nyathā kartuṃ kuta eva narādhipāḥ
english: Neither gods nor gandharvas, nor asuras, serpents, or rākṣasas, dare to make it otherwise — how then could kings of men?

sanskrit: tasmān mām anujānīta bhadraṃ vo 'stu nararṣabhāḥ adarśanaṃ gamiṣyāmi na māṃ drakṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
english: Therefore grant me leave, and may it be well with you, O bulls among men; I shall pass out of sight, where the Pāṇḍavas will not see me.

sanskrit: evaṃ vilapamānaṃ taṃ bhayād vyākulacetasam ātmakāryagarīyastvād rājā duryodhano 'bravīt
english: As he lamented thus, his mind distraught with fear, King Duryodhana, weighing the gravity of his own purpose, spoke to him.

sanskrit: na bhetavyaṃ naravyāghra ko hi tvā puruṣarṣabha madhye kṣatriyavīrāṇāṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ prārthayed yudhi
english: You must not fear, O tiger among men; for who, O bull among men, would assail you in battle as you stand amid the kṣatriya heroes?

sanskrit: ahaṃ vaikartanaḥ karṇaś citraseno viviṃśatiḥ bhūriśravāḥ śalaḥ śalyo vṛṣaseno durāsadaḥ
english: I myself, and Karṇa the son of Vikartana, Citrasena, Viviṃśati, Bhūriśravas, Śala, Śalya, and the unassailable Vṛṣasena;

sanskrit: purumitro jayo bhojaḥ kāmbojaś ca sudakṣiṇaḥ satyavrato mahābāhur vikarṇo durmukhaḥ sahaḥ
english: Purumitra, Jaya, the Bhoja, and Sudakṣiṇa of the Kāmbojas, the mighty-armed Satyavrata, Vikarṇa, Durmukha, and Saha;

sanskrit: duḥśāsanaḥ subāhuś ca kaliṅgaś cāpy udāyudhaḥ vindānuvindāv āvantyau droṇo drauṇiḥ sasaubalaḥ
english: Duḥśāsana and Subāhu, and the Kaliṅga too, weapons upraised, Vinda and Anuvinda of Avanti, Droṇa, Droṇa's son, and the son of Subala —

sanskrit: tvaṃ cāpi rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ svayaṃ śūro 'mitadyutiḥ sa kathaṃ pāṇḍaveyebhyo bhayaṃ paśyasi saindhava
english: and you yourself the best of chariot-warriors, a hero of boundless splendor — how then, O lord of the Sindhus, do you look in fear upon the Pāṇḍavas?

sanskrit: akṣauhiṇyo daśaikā ca madīyās tava rakṣaṇe yattā yotsyanti mā bhais tvaṃ saindhava vyetu te bhayam
english: Eleven akṣauhiṇīs of mine, intent upon your protection, shall stand in battle — fear not, O lord of the Sindhus, let your terror depart.

sanskrit: evam āśvāsito rājan putreṇa tava saindhavaḥ duryodhanena sahito droṇaṃ rātrāv upāgamat
english: Reassured thus, O king, by your son, the lord of the Sindhus, together with Duryodhana, went by night to Droṇa.

sanskrit: upasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā droṇāya sa viśāṃ pate upopaviśya praṇataḥ paryapṛcchad idaṃ tadā
english: Having paid homage to Droṇa, O lord of peoples, and seating himself near him in reverence, he then asked this:

sanskrit: nimitte dūrapātitve laghutve dṛḍhavedhane mama bravītu bhagavān viśeṣaṃ phalgunasya ca
english: In taking aim, in striking from afar, in swiftness of hand, in piercing firmly — let the blessed one tell me the difference between myself and Phalguna.

sanskrit: vidyāviśeṣam icchāmi jñātum ācārya tattvataḥ mamārjunasya ca vibho yathātattvaṃ pracakṣva me
english: I wish to know in truth, O teacher, the difference in skill between Arjuna and myself; declare it to me, O lord, exactly as it is.

sanskrit: droṇa uvāca samam ācāryakaṃ tāta tava caivārjunasya ca yogād duḥkhocitatvāc ca tasmāt tvatto 'dhiko 'rjunaḥ
english: Droṇa said: The instruction you received was the same, my child, as Arjuna's; yet through diligent practice and through being inured to hardship, Arjuna is therefore superior to you.

sanskrit: na tu te yudhi saṃtrāsaḥ kāryaḥ pārthāt kathaṃ cana ahaṃ hi rakṣitā tāta bhayāt tvāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
english: But you must feel no terror in battle on Pārtha's account in any way; for I shall be your protector from danger, my child — of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit: na hi madbāhuguptasya prabhavanty amarā api vyūhiṣyāmi ca taṃ vyūhaṃ yaṃ pārtho na tariṣyati
english: For against one guarded by my arm not even the immortals can prevail; and I shall array that battle-formation which Pārtha will not break through.

sanskrit: tasmād yudhyasva mā bhais tvaṃ svadharmam anupālaya pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mārgam anuyāhi narādhipa
english: Therefore fight, and fear not; uphold your own duty, and follow the path of your fathers and forefathers, O ruler of men.

sanskrit: adhītya vidhivad vedān agnayaḥ suhutās tvayā iṣṭaṃ ca bahubhir yajñair na te mṛtyubhayād bhayam
english: Having studied the Vedas as ordained, having duly fed the sacred fires, and having worshiped with many sacrifices, you need have no fear of death's terror.

sanskrit: durlabhaṃ mānuṣair mandair mahābhāgyam avāpya tu bhujavīryārjitāṃl lokān divyān prāpsyasy anuttamān
english: Having attained great good fortune, hard for feeble mortals to win, you shall reach the celestial, unsurpassed worlds, earned by the valor of your arms.

sanskrit: kuravaḥ pāṇḍavāś caiva vṛṣṇayo 'nye ca mānavāḥ ahaṃ ca saha putreṇa adhruvā iti cintyatām
english: The Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas, the Vṛṣṇis and other men, and I too together with my son — let it be considered that all are impermanent.

sanskrit: paryāyeṇa vayaṃ sarve kālena balinā hatāḥ paralokaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ svaiḥ svaiḥ karmabhir anvitāḥ
english: Each in his turn, all of us, struck down by mighty Time, shall pass to the other world, attended each by his own deeds.

sanskrit: tapas taptvā tu yāṃl lokān prāpnuvanti tapasvinaḥ kṣatradharmāśritāḥ śūrāḥ kṣatriyāḥ prāpnuvanti tān
english: Those worlds which ascetics attain by practicing austerity — those same worlds the heroic kṣatriyas attain who cleave to the warrior's duty.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca evam āśvāsito rājan bhāradvājena saindhavaḥ apānudad bhayaṃ pārthād yuddhāya ca mano dadhe
english: Saṃjaya said: Reassured thus, O king, by the son of Bharadvāja, the lord of the Sindhus drove away his fear of Pārtha and set his mind upon battle.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca pratijñāte tu pārthena sindhurājavadhe tadā vāsudevo mahābāhur dhanaṃjayam abhāṣata
english: Saṃjaya said: When Pārtha had vowed the slaying of the king of the Sindhus, then the mighty-armed Vāsudeva addressed Dhanaṃjaya.

sanskrit: bhrātṝṇāṃ matam ājñāya tvayā vācā pratiśrutam saindhavaṃ śvo 'smi hanteti tat sāhasatamaṃ kṛtam
english: Without learning the mind of your brothers, you have pledged with your word, 'Tomorrow I will slay the lord of the Sindhus' — a most reckless thing you have done.

sanskrit: asaṃmantrya mayā sārdham atibhāro 'yam udyataḥ kathaṃ nu sarvalokasya nāvahāsyā bhavemahi
english: Without taking counsel with me, this excessive burden has been taken up; how shall we not become a laughingstock to all the world?

sanskrit: dhārtarāṣṭrasya śibire mayā praṇihitāś carāḥ ta ime śīghram āgamya pravṛttiṃ vedayanti naḥ
english: Spies I had posted in the camp of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's son — these, coming swiftly, now report to us the tidings.

sanskrit: tvayā vai saṃpratijñāte sindhurājavadhe tadā siṃhanādaḥ savāditraḥ sumahān iha taiḥ śrutaḥ
english: When you had vowed the slaying of the king of the Sindhus, then a mighty lion-roar, mingled with instruments, was heard by them here.

sanskrit: tena śabdena vitrastā dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sasaindhavāḥ nākasmāt siṃhanādo 'yam iti matvā vyavasthitāḥ
english: Terrified by that sound, the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra together with the Saindhava took their stand, judging, 'This lion-roar is not without cause.'

sanskrit: sumahāñ śabdasaṃpātaḥ kauravāṇāṃ mahābhuja āsīn nāgāśvapattīnāṃ rathaghoṣaś ca bhairavaḥ
english: A vast clash of sound arose among the Kauravas, O mighty-armed one — of elephants, horses, and foot-soldiers — and the terrible din of chariots.

sanskrit: abhimanyuvadhaṃ śrutvā dhruvam ārto dhanaṃjayaḥ rātrau niryāsyati krodhād iti matvā vyavasthitāḥ
english: 'Having heard of Abhimanyu's slaying, surely Dhanaṃjaya in his anguish will sally forth this very night in wrath' — so judging, they stood ready.

sanskrit: tair yatadbhir iyaṃ satyā śrutā satyavatas tava pratijñā sindhurājasya vadhe rājīvalocana
english: By them, as they made ready, this truthful vow of yours, the truthful one, for the slaying of the king of the Sindhus was heard, O lotus-eyed one.

sanskrit: tato vimanasaḥ sarve trastāḥ kṣudramṛgā iva āsan suyodhanāmātyāḥ sa ca rājā jayadrathaḥ
english: Then dejected, all of them, trembling like little deer, were Suyodhana's counselors, and King Jayadratha as well.

sanskrit: athotthāya sahāmātyair dīnaḥ śibiram ātmanaḥ āyāt sauvīrasindhūnām īśvaro bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ
english: Then rising up with his counselors, downcast, the lord of the Sauvīras and the Sindhus, sorely grieved, came to his own tent.

sanskrit: sa mantrakāle saṃmantrya sarvā naiḥśreyasīḥ kriyāḥ suyodhanam idaṃ vākyam abravīd rājasaṃsadi
english: In the hour of counsel, having deliberated upon all the measures that might serve his welfare, he spoke these words to Suyodhana in the assembly of kings:

sanskrit: mām asau putrahanteti śvo 'bhiyātā dhanaṃjayaḥ pratijñāto hi senāyā madhye tena vadho mama
english: 'Branding me the slayer of his son, Dhanaṃjaya will march against me tomorrow; for in the midst of the army he has vowed my death.'

sanskrit: tāṃ na devā na gandharvā nāsuroragarākṣasāḥ utsahante 'nyathā kartuṃ pratijñāṃ savyasācinaḥ
english: 'That vow of Savyasācin, neither gods nor gandharvas, nor asuras, serpents, or rākṣasas dare to make otherwise.'

sanskrit: te māṃ rakṣata saṃgrāme mā vo mūrdhni dhanaṃjayaḥ padaṃ kṛtvāpnuyāl lakṣyaṃ tasmād atra vidhīyatām
english: 'Therefore guard me in the battle, lest Dhanaṃjaya, setting his foot upon your heads, attain his mark; let provision for this be made.'

sanskrit: atha rakṣā na me saṃkhye kriyate kurunandana anujānīhi māṃ rājan gamiṣyāmi gṛhān prati
english: 'But if no protection is granted me in the fray, O delight of the Kurus, then give me leave, O king — I shall return to my home.'

sanskrit: evam uktas tv avākśīrṣo vimanāḥ sa suyodhanaḥ śrutvābhiśaptavantaṃ tvāṃ dhyānam evānvapadyata
english: Addressed thus, Suyodhana, his head bowed and his spirit cast down, hearing that you had pronounced this dread oath, fell to brooding.

sanskrit: tam ārtam abhisaṃprekṣya rājā kila sa saindhavaḥ mṛdu cātmahitaṃ caiva sāpekṣam idam uktavān
english: Looking upon him so distressed, the king, the lord of the Sindhus, then spoke these words, gentle, mindful of his own welfare, and full of longing for aid:

sanskrit: nāhaṃ paśyāmi bhavatāṃ tathāvīryaṃ dhanurdharam yo 'rjunasyāstram astreṇa pratihanyān mahāhave
english: 'I see among you no bowman of such prowess as could ward off Arjuna's weapon with his own weapon in the great battle.'

sanskrit: vāsudevasahāyasya gāṇḍīvaṃ dhunvato dhanuḥ ko 'rjunasyāgratas tiṣṭhet sākṣād api śatakratuḥ
english: 'When he has Vāsudeva for his ally and brandishes the Gāṇḍīva bow, who could stand before Arjuna — even Śatakratu himself in person?'

sanskrit: maheśvaro 'pi pārthena śrūyate yodhitaḥ purā padātinā mahātejā girau himavati prabhuḥ
english: 'Even Maheśvara, it is told, was fought of old by Pārtha — the lord of mighty radiance, by one on foot, upon the Himālaya mountain.'

sanskrit: dānavānāṃ sahasrāṇi hiraṇyapuravāsinām jaghān ekarathenaiva devarājapracoditaḥ
english: 'Thousands of dānavas, dwellers in the City of Gold, he slew with a single chariot, urged on by the king of the gods.'

sanskrit: samāyukto hi kaunteyo vāsudevena dhīmatā sāmarān api lokāṃs trīn nihanyād iti me matiḥ
english: 'Joined with the wise Vāsudeva, the son of Kuntī could destroy the three worlds together with their gods — such is my conviction.'

sanskrit: so 'ham icchāmy anujñātuṃ rakṣituṃ vā mahātmanā droṇena sahaputreṇa vīreṇa yadi manyase
english: 'So I desire either to be given leave, or to be protected by the great-souled hero Droṇa together with his son — if you think it good.'

sanskrit: sa rājñā svayam ācāryo bhṛśam ākrandito 'rjuna saṃvidhānaṃ ca vihitaṃ rathāś ca kila sajjitāḥ
english: By the king himself the teacher was earnestly implored, O Arjuna; and so the arrangement was made, and the chariots, it is said, were made ready.

sanskrit: karṇo bhūriśravā drauṇir vṛṣasenaś ca durjayaḥ kṛpaś ca madrarājaś ca ṣaḍ ete 'sya purogamāḥ
english: Karṇa, Bhūriśravas, Droṇa's son, the unconquerable Vṛṣasena, and Kṛpa, and the king of the Madras — these six were his vanguard.

sanskrit: śakaṭaḥ padmapaś cārdho vyūho droṇena kalpitaḥ padmakarṇikamadhyasthaḥ sūcīpāśe jayadrathaḥ sthāsyate rakṣito vīraiḥ sindhurāḍ yuddhadurmadaiḥ
english: A half-formation shaped as a cart and a lotus was devised by Droṇa; and stationed at the heart of the lotus, within the needle's eye, the king of the Sindhus, Jayadratha, would stand, guarded by warriors mad for battle.

sanskrit: dhanuṣy astre ca vīrye ca prāṇe caiva tathorasi aviṣahyatamā hy ete niścitāḥ pārtha ṣaḍ rathāḥ etān ajitvā sagaṇān naiva prāpyo jayadrathaḥ
english: In bow, in weapon, in valor, in life-breath, and in steadfast chest, these six chariot-warriors are deemed most irresistible, O Pārtha; and without conquering them and their hosts, Jayadratha cannot be reached.

sanskrit: teṣām ekaikaśo vīryaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ tvam anucintaya sahitā hi naravyāghrā na śakyā jetum añjasā
english: Consider one by one the valor of those six; for those tigers among men, united, cannot easily be conquered.

sanskrit: bhūyaś ca cintayiṣyāmi nītim ātmahitāya vai mantrajñaiḥ sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ suhṛdbhiḥ kāryasiddhaye
english: And I shall further devise a policy for my own welfare, together with counselors skilled in deliberation and with friends, for the achievement of the end.

sanskrit: arjuna uvāca ṣaḍ rathān dhārtarāṣṭrasya manyase yān balādhikān teṣāṃ vīryaṃ mamārdhena na tulyam iti lakṣaye
english: Arjuna said: The six chariot-warriors of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's son whom you reckon superior in strength — their valor, I judge, is not equal to even half of mine.

sanskrit: astram astreṇa sarveṣām eteṣāṃ madhusūdana mayā drakṣyasi nirbhinnaṃ jayadrathavadhaiṣiṇā
english: The weapon of every one of these, O slayer of Madhu, you shall see shattered by my own weapon, as I seek the slaying of Jayadratha.

sanskrit: droṇasya miṣataḥ so 'haṃ sagaṇasya vilapyataḥ mūrdhānaṃ sindhurājasya pātayiṣyāmi bhūtale
english: Before the very eyes of Droṇa and his host, lamenting though they be, I shall bring down the head of the king of the Sindhus upon the earth.

sanskrit: yadi sādhyāś ca rudrāś ca vasavaś ca sahāśvinaḥ marutaś ca sahendreṇa viśvedevās tathāsurāḥ
english: If the Sādhyas and the Rudras, the Vasus together with the Aśvins, and the Maruts with Indra, the Viśvedevas, and the asuras as well;

sanskrit: pitaraḥ sahagandharvāḥ suparṇāḥ sāgarādrayaḥ dyaur viyat pṛthivī ceyaṃ diśaś ca sadigīśvarāḥ
english: the fathers together with the gandharvas, the great birds, the oceans and the mountains, the heaven, the firmament, and this earth, and the quarters with their guardian lords;

sanskrit: grāmyāraṇyāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca trātāraḥ sindhurājasya bhavanti madhusūdana
english: the creatures of village and forest, things that stand fast and things that move — if all these become protectors of the king of the Sindhus, O slayer of Madhu —

sanskrit: tathāpi bāṇair nihataṃ śvo draṣṭāsi raṇe mayā satyena te śape kṛṣṇa tathaivāyudham ālabhe
english: even then you shall see him slain tomorrow by my shafts in battle; by truth I swear it to you, Kṛṣṇa, and so I lay my hand upon my weapon.

sanskrit: yaś ca goptā maheṣvāsas tasya pāpasya durmateḥ tam eva prathamaṃ droṇam abhiyāsyāmi keśava
english: And that great bowman who guards that wicked, evil-minded one — against him, against Droṇa first, I shall advance, O Keśava.

sanskrit: tasmin dyūtam idaṃ baddhaṃ manyate sma suyodhanaḥ tasmāt tasyaiva senāgraṃ bhittvā yāsyāmi saindhavam
english: Upon him Suyodhana has staked this game; therefore, breaking through the very front of his host, I shall press on toward the Saindhava.

sanskrit: draṣṭāsi śvo maheṣvāsān nārācais tigmatejanaiḥ śṛṅgāṇīva girer vajrair dāryamāṇān mayā yudhi
english: You shall see tomorrow the great bowmen, with my keen-edged iron shafts, cleft asunder by me in battle, like the peaks of a mountain by thunderbolts.

sanskrit: naranāgāśvadehebhyo visraviṣyati śoṇitam patadbhyaḥ patitebhyaś ca vibhinnebhyaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
english: From the bodies of men, elephants, and horses, falling and fallen, riven by sharp arrows, the blood shall stream forth.

sanskrit: gāṇḍīvapreṣitā bāṇā manonilasamā jave nṛnāgāśvān videhāsūn kartāraś ca sahasraśaḥ
english: The arrows sped from the Gāṇḍīva, swift as the mind and the wind, shall by the thousand leave men, elephants, and horses bereft of life.

sanskrit: yamāt kuberād varuṇād rudrād indrāc ca yan mayā upāttam astraṃ ghoraṃ vai tad draṣṭāro narā yudhi
english: The dread weapons that I have received from Yama, Kubera, Varuṇa, Rudra, and Indra — those men shall behold in battle.

sanskrit: brāhmeṇāstreṇa cāstrāṇi hanyamānāni saṃyuge mayā draṣṭāsi sarveṣāṃ saindhavasyābhirakṣiṇām
english: And with the brāhma weapon you shall see the weapons of all the protectors of the Saindhava struck down by me in the fight.

sanskrit: śaravegasamutkṛttai rājñāṃ keśava mūrdhabhiḥ āstīryamāṇāṃ pṛthivīṃ draṣṭāsi śvo mayā yudhi
english: With the heads of kings shorn off by the rush of my arrows, you shall see the earth strewn over by me tomorrow in battle, O Keśava.

sanskrit: kravyādāṃs tarpayiṣyāmi drāvayiṣyāmi śātravān suhṛdo nandayiṣyāmi pātayiṣyāmi saindhavam
english: I shall sate the flesh-eaters, I shall put my foes to flight, I shall gladden my friends, and I shall lay low the Saindhava.

sanskrit: bahv āgaskṛt kusaṃbandhī pāpadeśasamudbhavaḥ mayā saindhavako rājā hataḥ svāñ śocayiṣyati
english: A doer of many wrongs, of evil kinship, sprung from a sinful land — slain by me, the king of the Sindhus shall set his own kin to mourning.

sanskrit: sarvakṣīrānnabhoktāraḥ pāpācārā raṇājire mayā sarājakā bāṇair nunnā naṃkṣyanti saindhavāḥ
english: Eaters of every milk-rich food, evil in conduct, the Sindhus together with their king, driven by my arrows on the field of battle, shall perish.

sanskrit: tathā prabhāte kartāsmi yathā kṛṣṇa suyodhanaḥ nānyaṃ dhanurdharaṃ loke maṃsyate matsamaṃ yudhi
english: At dawn I shall so act, Kṛṣṇa, that Suyodhana shall reckon no other bowman in the world to be my equal in battle.

sanskrit: gāṇḍīvaṃ ca dhanur divyaṃ yoddhā cāhaṃ nararṣabha tvaṃ ca yantā hṛṣīkeśa kiṃ nu syād ajitaṃ mayā
english: The Gāṇḍīva is a celestial bow, and I am the warrior, O bull among men, and you are my charioteer, Hṛṣīkeśa — what then could remain unconquered by me?

sanskrit: yathā hi lakṣma candre vai samudre ca yathā jalam evam etāṃ pratijñāṃ me satyāṃ viddhi janārdana
english: As surely as there is the mark upon the moon, and as surely as there is water in the sea, so surely know this vow of mine to be true, O Janārdana.

sanskrit: māvamaṃsthā mamāstrāṇi māvamaṃsthā dhanur dṛḍham māvamaṃsthā balaṃ bāhvor māvamaṃsthā dhanaṃjayam
english: Slight not my weapons, slight not my firm bow, slight not the strength of my arms, slight not Dhanaṃjaya.

sanskrit: yathā hi yātvā saṃgrāme na jīye vijayāmi ca tena satyena saṃgrāme hataṃ viddhi jayadratham
english: As surely as, having gone into battle, I am not vanquished but conquer — by that truth know Jayadratha already slain in the fray.
